title: 房租涨五百
setting: Sunday night, on your sofa. Your landlady only messages when something's up.

giveup.en: From next month, the rent goes up five hundred.
You said nothing, so she took it as a yes. Five hundred more, every month.

steps.narr: Sunday night. Your landlady never messages unless something's up.
steps.zh: 房东平时不找你，找你准没好事。

steps.en: There's something I need to tell you.

steps.zh: 从下个月开始，房租涨五百。
steps.en: From next month, the rent goes up by five hundred.

steps.zh: 现在什么都涨价，阿姨也没办法
steps.en: Everything's going up these days. My hands are tied.

say.en: Five hundred?! Tell her that's way too much.
answers: 五百？也太多了吧！
涨五百？太多了吧！
一下子涨五百，太多了！
五百也太多了！
say.gloss: Five hundred? That's way too much!
say.tip: 也太……了吧 = that's way too … (surprised, a bit indignant, still polite). 一下子 = all at once.

ok.zh: 你去附近问问，现在都是这个价。
ok.en: Go and ask around. That's the going rate now.
I've been very good to you, you know.

5.en: Five hundred?! Say, politely, that you understand her position, but it's far too much.
answers: 阿姨，理解您的难处，但一下子涨五百确实太多了。
我理解您的难处，可一下子涨五百也太多了吧。
阿姨，我能理解，但涨五百实在是太多了。
理解是理解，可五百也太贵了。
5.gloss: I understand your position, Auntie, but five hundred at once really is too much.
5.tip: 理解您的难处 = I understand your position (难处 = difficulty). Grant her point first, then 但……: polite persuasion.

say.en: Remind her you've always paid your rent on time.
answers: 我一直按时交房租的。
我每个月都按时交房租。
我从来没晚交过房租。
我交房租从来没拖过。
say.gloss: I've always paid my rent on time.

not.note: That says you DIDN'T pay on time.

say.tip: 按时 ànshí = on time. 交房租 = pay the rent (交 = hand in: 交作业, 交电费). 从来没……过 = not once, ever.

ok.zh: 这个阿姨知道，你是个好租客
ok.en: I know that. You're a good tenant.

5.en: Remind her, politely, that you've never once been late with the rent, as she well knows.
answers: 这几年我从没拖欠过房租，这您也是知道的。
我每个月都按时交租，这您也清楚。
阿姨，我从来没晚交过一天房租，您也知道的。
我交租一向准时，从来没拖过，您是知道的。
5.gloss: In all these years I've never once been behind on the rent, as you know.
5.tip: 拖欠 tuōqiàn = fall behind (on rent, on wages): 从没拖欠过 = never once been behind. 您也是知道的 = as you well know: it invites her to agree.

say.en: Ask if she could put it up by a bit less.
answers: 能不能少涨一点？
阿姨，能不能少涨点儿？
可以少涨一点吗？
少涨一点行不行？
say.gloss: Could you put it up a little less?
say.tip: 能不能……? = could you possibly …? 少涨一点: 少 before the verb means do less of it, 一点 after.

mistakes.note: 少 goes right before the verb and 一点 after it: 少涨一点.

alts.en: Offer to renew for another year if it stays the same
answers: 不涨的话，我再续一年。
房租不涨，我就续租一年。
alts.gloss: If it stays the same, I'll renew for another year.

then.en: Another year? Well… three hundred, then.

5.en: Ask her, at your most polite, if she could bend a little and raise it by less.
answers: 阿姨，您看能不能通融一下，少涨一点？
阿姨，我一直按时交租，您看能不能通融一下，少涨一点？
您看能不能照顾一下，少涨点儿？
王阿姨，能不能通融通融，少涨一点？
5.gloss: Auntie, could you possibly bend a little, and raise it by less?

answers: 要是房租不涨，我愿意跟您再续一年。
您要是不涨，我就再续租一年。
如果房租不变，我可以再续签一年。
alts.gloss: If the rent stays the same, I'd be glad to renew with you for another year.

5.tip: 通融 tōngróng = bend the rules a little, make an exception. 您看能不能……？ = would you consider …? The politest way to ask.

steps.zh: 合同上写着可以涨的，不信你看
steps.en: The contract says I can, you know. Look, if you don't believe me.

steps.zh: 第五条：租期内，房租不变。
steps.en: Clause 5: The rent stays the same for the length of the lease.

say.en: Read her photo. Point out the contract says the rent stays the same during the lease.
answers: 合同上写的是租期内房租不变。
阿姨，合同上写的是租期内不涨。
可是合同上说租期内房租不变啊。
合同写了租期内不能涨。
say.gloss: The contract says the rent stays the same during the lease.
say.tip: 合同上写的是…… = what the contract says is … . 租期内 = during the lease. 不变 = stays the same.

ok.en: Oh dear, I remembered it wrong.
Well… let's talk about it next year.

fail.en: What do you mean? Spell it out.

answers: 合同上写着呢，房租不变！
合同上写了，租期内不涨！
可是合同上写着不能涨啊。
合同写了房租不变！
3.gloss: It's right there in the contract: the rent stays the same!
3.tip: 合同上写着呢 = it's written right there in the contract (着呢: see, it's there). 不变 = stays the same.

5.en: Read her photo. Point out, politely, that it's there in black and white: the rent stays the same during the lease.
answers: 您看，合同上白纸黑字写着，租期内房租不变。
阿姨，合同上白纸黑字写着租期内不涨的。
合同第五条白纸黑字写着呢，租期内房租不变。
可是合同上白纸黑字写的是，租期内不能涨啊。
5.gloss: Look: it's there in the contract in black and white. The rent stays the same for the whole lease.
5.tip: 白纸黑字 = in black and white: written down, so there's no arguing with it. 租期内 = for the length of the lease.

say.en: End on a good note: thank her, and say you'll talk it over next year.
answers: 谢谢阿姨，明年再商量！
好的，谢谢阿姨！明年再说。
谢谢王阿姨，那明年再聊。
say.gloss: Thank you! Let's talk it over next year.
say.tip: 再商量 = talk it over again (商量 = discuss and agree). Ending warmly keeps a landlord on your side.

ok.zh: 唉，本来还想报个拉丁舞班呢。
ok.en: Sigh. I was going to sign up for a Latin dance class.
Oh well. Square dancing in the park it is.

5.en: End on a good note: thank her for understanding, and say you'll talk it over properly next year.
answers: 谢谢阿姨体谅，那咱们明年再好好商量。
谢谢您的体谅，阿姨，明年我们再商量。
谢谢阿姨理解，明年再坐下来好好聊。
阿姨，谢谢您通情达理，明年咱们再商量！
5.gloss: Thank you for understanding, Auntie. Let's talk it over properly next year.
5.tip: 体谅 tǐliàng = understanding, consideration: 谢谢您体谅 thanks her for giving way, and lets her keep face. 好好商量 = talk it over properly.

steps.en: The rent stays put until the lease is up. Your landlady's Latin dance career will have to wait.
